articles.title: Armor Taps Tech Veteran as CEO to Scale While Founder Focuses on Innovation
articles.summary: Plano-based cybersecurity and compliance services company Armor Defense brought aboard a new CEO with a longtime connection to founder Chris Drake. Nicholas Lee, former CEO of Dallas-based Fujitsu Intelligence, takes over day-to-day leadership as Drake shifts from CEO to chief innovation officer and remains on Armor’s board of directors. …

articles.title: SMU-Led Texoma Semiconductor Tech Hub Gets Nearly $29M for Chip Infrastructure, Talent
articles.summary: A regional semiconductor hub led by Southern Methodist University will use nearly $29 million in funding to help bulk up the region’s chip industry. The new funding for the Texoma Semiconductor Tech Hub will go toward developing semiconductor infrastructure, strengthening the semiconductor workforce and commercializing chip technology. …

articles.title: Gina Hinojosa won the governor’s race. What happens to Texas data centers now?
articles.summary: The governor-elect has called for a data center moratorium to last until the Texas Legislature meets in January to pass “real protections so Texans can have a seat at the table.”

articles.title: Data center heists are getting bolder, and the latest one hit Nvidia for $11.4 million
articles.summary: According to the Bay Area News Group, police suspect that sophisticated thieves stole $11.4 million worth of Nvidia equipment that was supposed to ship from Oakland to Fort Worth, Texas. No arrests have been announced so far. Read Entire Article
